BRACE 2/6

Pause
Normal
PRIMARY
Quads
SECONDARY
Glutes, Core

Instructions

Preparation: Shoulder-harness variation: use a fitted harness and start light. Set both shoulder pads and bar catches before lifting from a rack. Keep feet planted; brace before each squat.

1

Stand tall; keep the harness supported.

2

Brace; keep both feet firmly planted.

3

Bend hips and knees; keep heels grounded.

4

Keep chest lifted and knees tracking outward.

5

Push through your whole feet to stand.

6

Stay braced with both hands stabilising.

Watch out

Keep the harness supported on both shoulders and the bar secure in its catches.

COMMON MISTAKES

Letting the harness tip or lose shoulder contact.
Lifting your heels or letting knees collapse inward.
Losing your brace or leaning far forward.
